title: John Bible Quiz - Chapter 3
description: Ten questions on John 3: Nicodemus by night, being born anew, God's love for the world, and John's words about the bridegroom.

questions.text: Who came to Jesus by night?
questions.explanation: There was a man of the Pharisees named Nicodemus, a ruler of the Jews, who came to him by night.

answers.text: Joseph of Arimathaea, a member of the council
A priest sent from Jerusalem by the Levites
One of John's disciples from beyond the Jordan
Nicodemus, a Pharisee and ruler of the Jews

questions.text: What did Jesus say a person must be in order to see God's Kingdom?
questions.explanation: Jesus answered that unless one is born anew, he can't see God's Kingdom.

answers.text: Baptized by John
Born anew
A teacher of Israel
Circumcised on the Sabbath

questions.text: What did Nicodemus ask in reply?
questions.explanation: Nicodemus asked how a man can be born when he is old, and whether he can enter a second time into his mother's womb and be born.

answers.text: Where he should go to be baptized
Which of the prophets had said this
How a man can be born when he is old
Whether the Kingdom was already near

questions.text: What did Jesus compare everyone who is born of the Spirit to?
questions.explanation: He said the wind blows where it wants to, and you hear its sound but don't know where it comes from or where it is going, and so is everyone who is born of the Spirit.

answers.text: The wind, which blows where it wants to
A lamp set on a stand
A seed sown in good ground
A well of water in the desert

questions.text: What did Jesus say the lifting up of the Son of Man is like?
questions.explanation: He said that as Moses lifted up the serpent in the wilderness, even so must the Son of Man be lifted up.

answers.text: The manna given in the wilderness
The ark carried over the Jordan
The lamp lifted up in the temple
Moses lifting up the serpent in the wilderness

questions.text: What did God give because he so loved the world?
questions.explanation: God so loved the world that he gave his one and only Son, so that whoever believes in him should not perish but have eternal life.

answers.text: His one and only Son
The law through Moses
The Spirit without measure
A voice crying in the wilderness

questions.text: What does the chapter say the judgment is?
questions.explanation: This is the judgment: the light has come into the world, and men loved the darkness rather than the light, for their works were evil.

answers.text: That the Son was sent into the world to judge it
That the light has come into the world and men loved the darkness
That no one has ever ascended into heaven
That the law was given to the world through Moses

questions.text: Where was John baptizing, and why there?
questions.explanation: John was baptizing in Enon near Salim, because there was much water there.

answers.text: In Cana of Galilee, because a wedding was held there
In Jerusalem, because the Passover was near
In Enon near Salim, because there was much water there
In Judea, because Jesus was baptizing there

questions.text: In John's answer, who rejoices greatly because of the bridegroom's voice?
questions.explanation: He said that the one who has the bride is the bridegroom, but the friend of the bridegroom, who stands and hears him, rejoices greatly because of the bridegroom's voice.

answers.text: The friend of the bridegroom, who stands and hears him
The bride, who waits for the bridegroom
The ruler of the feast, who tastes the wine
The servants who pour out the wine

questions.text: How did John describe what must happen to the other and to himself?
questions.explanation: John said, "He must increase, but I must decrease."

answers.text: "We must both baptize together"
"He must go away, and I must stay"
"I must increase, and he must wait"
"He must increase, but I must decrease"
